description:
Create a reusable demographics module and transfer it between surveys. 

1. Create a new survey titled 'Lab Master Template'.
2. Create a Question Group titled 'Standard Demographics' in this survey.
3. Add three questions to this group with exact codes:
   - Code: DEMO_AGE (Numerical input) - Text: 'What is your age in years?'
   - Code: DEMO_EDU (List/Radio) - Text: 'What is the highest degree or level of school you have completed?' (Options: E1='Less than high school', E2='High school graduate', E3='Some college or Associate degree', E4='Bachelor\'s degree', E5='Graduate or professional degree')
   - Code: DEMO_EMP (Yes/No) - Text: 'Are you currently employed for wages or salary?'
4. Export this Question Group as an .lsg file to '/home/ga/Documents/standard_demographics.lsg'.
5. Create a second survey titled 'Social Interaction Study 2024'.
6. Import the 'standard_demographics.lsg' file into this new survey.
7. Ensure only the 'Standard Demographics' group remains in the second survey (delete any default groups).
